application_review: A finite dependent product of groups with proved global Euclidean diffeomorphisms receives its original product topology and a global chart from their product homeomorphism. Every literal component projection is smooth; smooth componentwise maps assemble into smooth maps on that same product.

The original coordinatewise product-group multiplication and inversion are proved smooth using the actual component operations in global coordinates. This constructs a genuine Lie group on the existing product group, without replacing its multiplication.

The existing joint native array group now has a complete finite-dimensional real normed model, a global product exponential diffeomorphism, its original Lie group structure and smooth component evaluations. Contractibility and hence simple connectedness follow from the proved global parametrization.

The actual finite joint native array group and exact product of all-integer pointwise original lattices instantiate NativeNilmanifoldData at the same common step. Discreteness, compact coset space, finite-dimensional complete model, compatible quotient metric and step bound are obtained from retained proofs; explicit equalities identify the group and lattice fields.

The exact joint coset space has a constructed smooth manifold structure on its original coset topology. Original quotient projection and every component integer-input coset evaluation are smooth. Componentwise integer shifts and their quotient maps are smooth, with opposite-shift smooth inverses assembled into actual quotient diffeomorphisms.

Reviewed topology and operations: the global product chart uses the inherited product topology, original component exponentials and original coordinatewise group law. Smoothness of group operations is proved before installing the new Lie-group theorem.

Reviewed product source charts: normed-space product smooth maps use the actual self chart, via contDiff_fst/contDiff_snd and prodMk_space, rather than silently identifying the ModelProd chart instance with the self-chart instance.

Reviewed joint interface identity: the native constructor is applied to the actual joint group and exact original product lattice, with explicit group/lattice equality theorems. The same common nilpotency step is used; the compatible metric is constructed by the retained constructor.

Reviewed quotient smoothness: the retained discrete-coset construction acts on the actual quotient. Component evaluations and shift maps descend using their literal representative formulas. Quantitative uniform bounds and later calibration are not inferred from qualitative smoothness.
All named declarations are strictly elaborated and checked for transitive axioms. Prior sources and prior axiom sets remain unchanged. No independent kernel replay or full-target proof is claimed.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved. Cocompactness of the exact all-integer pointwise lattice is now proved by actual lattice monomial spanning, rational-log intersection, positive-root character descent and continuous quotient transfer. The actual integrated subalgebra and full native array group now have constructed smooth manifold and Lie group structures on their inherited topologies, and all literal integer evaluations are smooth. The actual array group and exact lattice instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the same original nilpotency step, with constructed compatible quotient metric. Integer input translations now preserve the actual graded coefficient Lie algebra, the full native exponential array group and its exact all-integer lattice; actual group and coset homeomorphisms and continuous coset evaluation with exact translation compatibility are proved. Array input translations are now proved smooth with smooth inverses in the existing original exponential charts. Original affine power-times-basepoint model arrays are proved to belong to the actual native array group; their exact evaluations, input translations and linear time orbit are proved both in the group and in its exact lattice coset space. Actual original and array discrete-lattice quotient manifolds are now constructed on the retained coset topologies; original quotient projections, all integer-input quotient evaluations and original quotient translations are smooth, with the latter having proved smooth inverses. The dependent product joint group, its exact product lattice, compact coset space, common nilpotency cutoff, original joint model orbit, component evaluations and input shifts are now constructed with exact formulas. The finite joint group now has its constructed finite-dimensional complete Lie model, global product exponential diffeomorphism and original smooth group operations, and instantiates NativeNilmanifoldData with the exact joint group, exact lattice and same common step. The original joint quotient is a smooth manifold with smooth component integer evaluations and smooth input-shift diffeomorphisms. Uniform quantitative smooth-observable bounds, model-reading calibration and downstream probabilistic estimates remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the connection of the constructed joint model to all prescribed quantitative readings, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
